title: Process a book checkout
description: A librarian can issue a book copy to a borrower and see the checkout confirmation and receipt.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with {{LOGIN_USER}}
Fill in the password field with {{LOGIN_PASSWORD}}
Submit the login form
Open the checkout page
Fill in the borrower ID field with a valid borrower identifier
Fill in the book copy ID field with a valid book copy identifier
Submit the checkout form
Verify the checkout confirmation is visible
Verify the loan receipt is displayed

title: Complete a book return
description: This verifies that a librarian can submit a valid book copy ID on the return page and receive a completed check-in confirmation with receipt details.

steps.description: Navigate to /login

Submit the login form
Navigate to /librarian/checkin.php
Fill in a valid book copy ID into the book copy ID field
Submit the return form
Verify a check-in confirmation is visible
Verify receipt details are displayed
